analysis: Independent high-impact fresh review re-read the current WD-003 build_round 9 Contract, references, verification, builder submission, REVIEW.json, review_pack.json, ACTUAL_DIFF.txt, DIB machine evidence, and the current source call chain. The reviewed implementation keeps 0x9F as the CP4C capability gate, leaves 0x95 sleep wait time behavior unchanged, uses 0x97 only for side-switch read/write verification, and uses 0x87 only for one ordinary key mode/key readback at a time. The 0x87 parser rejects frames over 64 bytes, nonzero success status, unsupported action types, out-of-range mode/key indexes, inconsistent description length, and action+description payloads over 53 bytes; status 3 is surfaced as an explicit too-large single-packet readback failure instead of guessing or truncating data. Side-switch Custom actions are still wrapped as 0x73 or 0x74 envelopes with length bytes and the 52-byte 0x97 readback budget is enforced. Current source search and DIB evidence show no 0x98 ordinary-key readback path and no USB mi_00/col02 configuration-channel fallback. StudioController sequences readback as 0x97 first, then per-key 0x87, verifies saves with 0x97 and 0x87 comparisons, preserves failed/unverified drafts, and logs CP4C_INPUT_FAILURE with catalogKey/cmd/mode/keyIndex/phase/reason. StudioState keeps passive readback on inputBaselineRevision and avoids overwriting modes with unsaved drafts. InspectorPane rebuilds on CP4C/readback baseline changes and exposes side-switch Custom single-key, combination shortcut, and short macro editing while keeping unified Save. No blocking fresh-review findings were found. This fresh review pass is not formal Owner UAT, not true-device formal PASS, not a Git candidate, not a formal build, not a release, and not publication; those delivery gates remain separate.
